wall_thickness_mm.rationale: Standard FDM parameter: 4-5 perimeters with a 0.4mm nozzle to provide rigidity and eliminate warping without excessive print time.

clearance_mm.rationale: 0.5mm drop-in clearance absorbs typical ±0.15mm FDM printer dimensional deviation and ±0.2mm PCB CNC routing edge tolerance.

standoff_height_mm.rationale: Elevates PCB 3.5mm above floor, clearing bottom through-hole solder pins and surface mount components (1.8mm max) plus ventilation.

heat_set_insert_spec.rationale: Follows CNC Kitchen / McMaster-Carr insert standards. Annular boss wall >=1.0mm prevents hoop stress blowout during hot soldering-iron insertion.

tongue_and_groove_joint.rationale: 0.2mm horizontal tolerance gap ensures smooth lid sliding/friction mating without binding; 0.3mm groove depth relief guarantees rims mate flush.
